simple.meaning: אֲבִימָאֵל (ʼĂbîymâʼêl) is a Hebrew word meaning “Abimael , a son of Joktan.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: אֲבִימָאֵל (H39) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 10:28, with occurrences in Genesis, 1 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אֲבִימָאֵל (H39) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in אֲבִימָאֵל (H39) before moving outward to related references.
